WITH repeat_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
  FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`
  GROUP BY customer_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
),
period_orders AS (
  SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date, status, amount
  FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-10'
)
SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'cancelled' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_eur,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'cancelled' AND customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM repeat_customers) THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_repeat_customers_eur,
  CASE 
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'cancelled' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'cancelled' AND customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM repeat_customers) THEN amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'cancelled' THEN amount ELSE 0 END)
  END AS repeat_revenue_share
FROM period_orders
